# MockMesh

> MockMesh is an open-source Python library that intercepts AWS, Azure, GCP, SQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and HTTP calls at transport level, providing real stateful local mocking of 60+ cloud services with zero credentials and zero cost.

## Installation
pip install mockmesh

## Quick Start
```python
import mockmesh
mockmesh.initialize()

# All boto3, azure-sdk, google-cloud, pymongo, redis, SQL, Kafka, and HTTP calls
# are now intercepted locally — no cloud credentials needed.
```

## Pages
- [Home](https://mockmesh.dev/): Overview, features, and comparison with LocalStack and Moto
- [Services](https://mockmesh.dev/services): All 60+ mocked services and operations (AWS, Azure, GCP, SQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, HTTP)
- [Install](https://mockmesh.dev/install): Installation guide, pytest integration, API parameters
- [Docs](https://mockmesh.dev/docs): Architecture, providers, config, fallback modes, plugins, troubleshooting

## Key Features
- Mock 17 AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, SecretsManager, SSM, RDS, ElastiCache, Lambda)
- Mock 13 Azure services (Blob Storage, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Key Vault, Event Hubs)
- Mock 8 GCP services (Cloud Storage, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager, BigQuery, Spanner)
- Mock SQL databases via psycopg2, pymysql, asyncpg, aiomysql with SQLite backend
- Mock MongoDB (pymongo) and Redis (redis-py) with in-memory stores
- Mock Kafka (confluent-kafka, kafka-python) and RabbitMQ (pika)
- Mock any HTTP endpoint via requests and urllib interceptors
- Real stateful file-backed storage
- Zero Docker dependency — pure Python
- pytest integration with session and per-test isolation
